name: automation_denial_1743
command: tell application "System Events" to set picture of every desktop to POSIX file "/Users/me/Pictures/wall.jpg"
stderr: execution error: Not authorised to send Apple events to System Events. (-1743)
remediation: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation → allow the launching app to control System Events
note: Classification must key on the -1743 code, not the human-readable text: osascript messages are localized (this host reports in Spanish).
